purpose: Focused Protected-Mode Ghidra closure for the 01F7:199D -> 01E7:0CE3 transition-effect edge.

source.independent_projects: project-a and project-b decompilation/listing outputs matched

contracts.name: address_named_transition_effect_01E7_0CE3
contracts.calling_convention: far; no caller-consumed return flags; 01F7:199D calls it after publishing DS:89EA
contracts.inputs_outputs: Reads DS:5044; calls 0227:05CD with AX=0; if enabled writes DS:504C=0x18, then calls 01E7:33D5 with BX=8, CX=0x40, DX=0x3F; RETF at 0x0D09
contracts.scheduler_position: Synchronous death/transition boundary called by 01F7:199D; before the 199D motion/reset writes return to the player callback boundary
contracts.object_effects: Publishes external transition/effect state and delegates FFFF parameter publication; no object allocation
contracts.feeds_back_into_simulation: No direct player/MAP/descriptor/scheduler write; DS:504C remains an external transition/effect state contract

contracts.name: address_named_effect_parameter_writer_01E7_33D5
contracts.calling_convention: far; inputs BX/CX/DX; saves and restores DS and CX; RETF at 0x33EB
contracts.inputs_outputs: Writes FFFF:2FE9=BX, FFFF:2FEB=low-byte(-CX), FFFF:2FEC=DL; no stable return flags
contracts.scheduler_position: Nested effect-parameter leaf in 01E7:0CE3; no scheduler invocation
contracts.object_effects: Publishes three FFFF-segment effect/runtime parameter bytes/words; no object creation or callback dispatch
contracts.feeds_back_into_simulation: No direct player or DS callback-global write; presentation/runtime parameter only at this boundary

contracts.name: address_named_stack_probe_0227_05CD
contracts.calling_convention: far runtime stack probe; AX is the requested stack size; fast path RETF at 0x05EA, failure branches to 0227:026D
contracts.inputs_outputs: Checks AX+0x200 against SP and SS:[0x0A]/SS:[0x0E]; lowers SS:[0x0E] when the new distance is smaller; no gameplay return flags
contracts.scheduler_position: Runtime guard nested at the start of 01E7:0CE3; no scheduler invocation
contracts.object_effects: Only protects the runtime stack; failure transfers to the runtime handler at 0227:026D
contracts.feeds_back_into_simulation: No; it cannot modify the player record or callback globals on the normal fast path

stopping_rule: The effect/runtime leaf is closed at FFFF-only parameter publication and the stack guard. Do not expand 0227:026D unless a normal gameplay trace shows stack exhaustion or a player parity mismatch reaches it.
